brief:
A group of former Israeli military generals has offered assistance to Palestinian olive farmers in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The initiative represents an unusual collaboration between Israeli military figures and Palestinian agricultural communities in a territory marked by longstanding tensions.

Details on the specific nature of the assistance and the scope of the engagement were not immediately available. The effort appears aimed at supporting Palestinian agricultural livelihoods in the West Bank.
dek: A group of former Israeli military generals offered their help to Palestinian olive farmers in the occupied West Bank.
title: Former Israeli generals assist Palestinian olive farmers in West Bank
